children: Japanese stocks might remain rangebound as uncertainty over the Iran conflict and the Federal Reserve's policy outlook continues. Nikkei futures are flat at 65460 on the SGX. The dollar is at 158.81 yen, compared with Y158.40 as of Thursday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are closely watching bond yields following gains in U.S. Treasury yields overnight due to rising expectations for further rate increases by the Fed. The Nikkei Stock Average rose 0.8% to 65513.99 on Thursday. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com)
